products_image_alt_required.name: products_image_alt_required
products_image_alt_required.value: "products"."image_url" is null or ("products"."image_alt_fr" is not null and "products"."image_alt_en" is not null)

orders_customer_identified.name: orders_customer_identified
orders_customer_identified.value: "orders"."user_id" is not null or "orders"."guest_email" is not null

orders_amounts_nonnegative.name: orders_amounts_nonnegative
orders_amounts_nonnegative.value: "orders"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."reward_discount_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."delivery_fee_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."gst_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."qst_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."tip_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."total_cents" >= 0

orders_delivery_fields.name: orders_delivery_fields
orders_delivery_fields.value: ("orders"."fulfilment" = 'delivery') = ("orders"."delivery_zone_id" is not null and "orders"."delivery_address" is not null)

loyalty_programs_referral.name: loyalty_programs_referral
loyalty_programs_referral.value: "loyalty_programs"."referrer_stamps" between 0 and 10 and "loyalty_programs"."referee_stamps" between 0 and 10 and "loyalty_programs"."referral_min_order_cents" >= 0 and "loyalty_programs"."referral_monthly_cap" between 1 and 50

loyalty_programs_reward.name: loyalty_programs_reward
loyalty_programs_reward.value: ("loyalty_programs"."reward_value_cap_cents" is null or "loyalty_programs"."reward_value_cap_cents" > 0) and ("loyalty_programs"."reward_expiry_days" is null or "loyalty_programs"."reward_expiry_days" > 0)

loyalty_transactions_sign.name: loyalty_transactions_sign
loyalty_transactions_sign.value:
case "loyalty_transactions"."kind"::text
        when 'earn' then "loyalty_transactions"."stamps" > 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" = 0
        when 'convert' then "loyalty_transactions"."stamps" < 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" = 0
        when 'reverse' then "loyalty_transactions"."stamps" <= 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" >= 0
        when 'repay' then "loyalty_transactions"."stamps" < 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" = "loyalty_transactions"."stamps"
        when 'revoke' then "loyalty_transactions"."stamps" >= 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" = 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."reward_id" is not null
        when 'adjust' then ("loyalty_transactions"."stamps" <> 0 or "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" < 0) and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" <= 0
        else "loyalty_transactions"."stamps" = 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."debt_delta" = 0 and "loyalty_transactions"."reward_id" is not null
      end

store_settings_ranges.name: store_settings_ranges
store_settings_ranges.value: "store_settings"."prep_minutes" between 0 and 240 and "store_settings"."slot_minutes" between 5 and 120 and "store_settings"."days_ahead" between 0 and 14 and "store_settings"."order_cutoff_minutes" between 0 and 240 and "store_settings"."min_lead_minutes" between 0 and 1440 and ("store_settings"."max_orders_per_slot" is null or "store_settings"."max_orders_per_slot" > 0) and "store_settings"."unpaid_ttl_minutes" between 5 and 120
